description: This file is a Makefile used for managing package feeds in a Linux-based embedded system, specifically related to OpenWrt/LEDE project feeds management and package repository configuration.

methods.name: FeedPackageDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for a specific package feed, taking into account configuration and directory structure.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendOPKG
methods.description: Generates and appends repository source entries for OPKG package management system into a given file.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendAPK
methods.description: Generates and appends repository source entries for APK package management system into a given file.

methods.name: GetABISuffix
methods.description: Retrieves the ABI suffix for a specified package, either from a predefined variable or by parsing version info.

methods.name: FormatABISuffix
methods.description: Formats the ABI suffix based on the package name and versioning information.
